description: The language codes Equalang takes, with their names, read from the live API. Needs no key. Use it to turn a language's name into its code.

kind.description: file (default): the languages translate_file takes; text: the wider set translate_text takes.

matching.description: Only languages whose name or code contains this, e.g. "chinese" or "pt".
